purpose: Independent non-coplanar metric evidence for game-level physical camera centre. Event 489 is excluded from the fit.
coordinate_system: basket-local centimetres: +X from backboard face toward court, +Y across court, Z=0 floor
annotation_policy: Source-pixel orange-rim centre observations from the selected same-physical-camera samples. These are independent of the event-489 v26 backboard-target landmarks and independent of the retired v26 baseline anchors. Event 489 does not enter the game-level fit.
guardrails: Do not transport event-489 metric landmarks into these events.
Do not use the retired v1/v26 physical centre as a fit prior.
Passing this evidence may promote only the game-level physical centre; exact event camera and replay remain separate gates.
